errors.network: No connection. Check your internet and try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a little and try again.
errors.sessionEnded: You were signed out. Sign in again.

locked.title: Your location is locked
locked.body: Only your friends' phones can open it. Not even our server can see it.

precision.title: You choose how much they see
precision.body: Per circle: your exact spot, your neighbourhood or just the city.

ghost.title: Disappear any time
ghost.body: Turn on ghost mode and nobody sees where you are. One tap.

email.title: Your email
email.body: We'll send you a 4-digit sign-in code. No password, no phone number.
email.label: Email

code.title: Enter the code
code.body: We sent a 4-digit code to {{email}}. Check your inbox.
code.label: Sign-in code, 4 digits
code.resent: A new code is on its way.
code.oneDevice: Bargu is open on one phone at a time. If it's open on another phone, that one is signed out.
code.expired: This code has expired. Ask for a new one.
code.locked: Too many wrong attempts. Ask for a new code.
code.hint: Type the code, or copy it from the email and paste it.
code.messageBody: Copied the code? Paste it here

passkey.noCredential: There is no Bargu passkey on this phone. Sign in with an email code, then add one under "Me".
passkey.failed: Passkey sign-in did not work. Try an email code.

username.title: Pick a username
username.body: Friends find you by this name. No phone number or contacts needed.
username.label: Username
username.rules: 3–20 characters: lowercase letters, digits, dot and underscore.
username.taken: That name is taken, try another.
username.invalid: 3–20 characters: lowercase letters, digits, dot and underscore.

profile.title: How should friends see you?
profile.nameInvalid: 1–40 characters, with at least one visible letter or emoji.
profile.preview: This is how you'll look on the map

seers.hint: Shows who sees you; you can stop it all from there

circles.title: Circles
circles.emptyBody: Friends you add show up here. Nothing is shared until they accept.

add.title: Add a friend
add.soon: Adding friends arrives in the next update.

me.title: Me
me.logoutBody: The encryption keys on this phone are deleted. When you sign in again, new keys are created and your friends see that your device changed.
me.passkeyAdd: Add one: fast, secure sign-in without email codes
me.passkeyExists: This phone already has a Bargu passkey.
me.passkeyFailed: Could not add the passkey. Try again.
me.mapDataDetail: © OpenStreetMap contributors · ODbL licence · Weather: Open-Meteo (CC BY 4.0)
me.statusNone: Share an emoji and a few words

activity.settled: in the same place for a while

crypto.title: Crypto benchmark
crypto.budget: Target: encrypting a location under {{ms}} ms (p95).
crypto.notPassed: Not passed: encryption is over budget.
crypto.backendNative: Curve operations: the phone's native crypto (self-test passed)

ui.title: Components
ui.fpsResult: Average {{avg}} fps · worst frame {{worst}} ms · {{dropped}} frames dropped

swarm.title: Test: {{count}} fake people on the map (this phone only)

scan.permissionTitle: The camera is only used for QR codes
scan.permissionBody: Bargu needs the camera to read your friend's code. Nothing is recorded or sent anywhere.

add.showQrHint: Fastest when you're together: they scan it
add.scanHint: Scan the code on your friend's screen
add.scanBody: Fit your friend's Bargu QR code inside the frame.

username.helper: You see their card first, then the request goes out.
username.sent: Request sent to {{name}}. We'll let you know when they accept.
username.notFound: Nobody has this username. Check the spelling.

qr.label: Add-a-friend QR code
qr.body: Your friend taps "Scan a QR code" in Bargu and scans this; you become friends right away. Single use, valid for 24 hours. Screenshots are blocked for your safety.
qr.circleBody: Whoever scans this code can join the circle. Single use, valid for 24 hours.
qr.eventBody: Valid until the event ends: everyone who scans it joins (up to 50 people). Only show it to people you are with.
qr.revokeFailed: The old code could not be revoked and still works. Check your connection and try again.

invite.title: Invitation
invite.body: If you accept, you can share your locations with each other, end-to-end encrypted. You can leave any time.
invite.invalid: This invitation is invalid or has expired
invite.invalidBody: Invite links work once and for 24 hours. Ask your friend for a new one.
invite.usedByMe: You already joined once with this code. Ask for a new one to join again.
invite.eventBody: If you join, you share your locations with each other until the event ends; everything is end-to-end encrypted. When it ends, the circle is deleted for everyone.

errors.full: This circle is full (50 people at most).
errors.gone: This circle no longer exists or you're not in it.
errors.creatorAdmin: Whoever created the circle stays its admin.

sheet.friendRequest: Wants to add you as a friend

new.title: New circle
new.body: Set up a circle for your family or friends, then invite people. Anyone who hasn't accepted sees nothing.
new.name: Circle name
new.inviteBody: Tap to pick; you can add more later. Anyone who hasn't accepted sees nothing.
new.body_event: A concert, a trip, a match… When its end comes, the circle deletes itself.

detail.goneBody: You may have left it or been removed.
detail.encryptedBody: Locations open only on the phones of the people here. Not even Bargu's server can see them.
detail.waitingBody: Keys still to arrive: {{count}}. It completes by itself once they open the app.
detail.pendingBody: You'll see {{name}} here once they accept. Nothing is shared until then.
detail.keyChangedBody: It may be a new phone. Until you're sure, your location isn't sent to them and their key isn't used.
detail.acceptKeyBody: If {{name}} changed phones, you can accept. Safest is to meet and compare with the QR code.
detail.removeBody: They won't see any further locations; new keys go only to those who stay.
detail.leaveBody: People in this circle won't see your location any more, and you won't see theirs.
detail.unfriendBody: Neither of you will see the other's location. Becoming friends again needs a new request.
detail.onlyYouBody: Invite your friends; those who accept join the circle.

invite.title: Add people
invite.sent: Invited: {{count}}. We'll let you know when they accept.
invite.noFriendsBody: Invite with one of the ways below. Friends you add show up here, one tap each.
invite.byUsernameHint: For someone not in your friends

event.note: When the event ends, this circle and everything in it (locations, places, keys) is deleted for everyone.
event.endConfirmBody: The circle is deleted for everyone at once; this cannot be undone.
event.closeDoorBody: Every QR code and link of the event stops working, whoever made it. People already in stay; make a new code for anyone else.

verify.title: Safety number
verify.body: Meet in person: one of you taps "Scan their code" and scans the other's screen. Or compare the 60 digits together; if they match, nobody is in between.
verify.matched: {{name}} is verified. Nobody is in between.
verify.mismatchBody: Make sure you scanned the right person's code. If it still doesn't match, don't share your location with them.

notices.friendRequest: {{name}} wants to add you as a friend
notices.keyChanged: {{names}}'s safety number changed. Tap to check.

notice.friendRequest: You have a new friend request
notice.circleInvite: You were invited to a circle
notice.memberJoinedHistory: Someone joined your circle; they can now see your location history too
notice.memberJoinedHistoryIn: Someone joined {{circle}}; they can now see your location history too
notice.memberJoinedSees: Someone joined your circle; they can now see your location too
notice.memberJoinedSeesIn: Someone joined {{circle}}; they can now see your location too
notice.memberJoinedBoth: Someone joined your circle; they can now see your location and location history too
notice.memberJoinedBothIn: Someone joined {{circle}}; they can now see your location and location history too

mute.title: Notifications from {{name}}
mute.hint: What you turn off goes quiet on this phone only; the server never learns whom you muted.

service.title: Sharing your location
service.body: Your circles see you on the map. Turn on ghost mode to stop.

permission.title: Location permission needed
permission.body: So your friends can see you on the map. Your location is encrypted on your phone; not even our server can see it.
permission.blockedBody: Location is turned off for Bargu. Allow it "while using the app" in Settings to start sharing.

sharing.title: Your location
sharing.toggleGroup: This circle can see your location
sharing.off: Off: your location does not go to this circle.
sharing.always: On until you turn it off.
sharing.ghostOn: You are a ghost: nobody sees your location right now.
sharing.historyDetail: Off. Turn it on and people in this circle can see where you went over the last 14 days. Encrypted on your phone, unreadable to the server, deleted after 14 days. Anyone joining later cannot see what came before. Turning it off deletes it from the server too.
sharing.historyExactOnly: History is only kept while you share your exact location.
sharing.historyNobody: On · Nobody else is in this circle yet.
sharing.historyOff: History turned off and deleted from the server
sharing.historyOffLater: History turned off; it is deleted from the server once you are online

precision.exactDetail: They see exactly where you are.
precision.neighborhoodDetail: They only see which area you are in (about 1 km).
precision.cityDetail: They only see which city you are in (about 10 km).

ghost.title: Ghost mode
ghost.offDetail: Your circles see you at the detail you chose.
ghost.freezeDetail: Your last location stays on the map; no new one is sent.
ghost.hideDetail: You disappear from everyone’s map; no location is sent.

newPhone.title: Your location is shared with no one on this phone
newPhone.body: The app was reinstalled. Your privacy settings stayed with the old install, so your location goes to no circle until you choose.

location.newViewer: {{name}} can now see your location in {{circle}}
location.newViewerBoth: {{name}} can now see your location and location history in {{circle}}

reminder.title: Weekly reminder
reminder.notification: Have a look at who sees your location; stop it with one tap if you like.

card.coarse: Approximate location (they share their area or city with you)

poke.limited: Wait a moment, that was a lot of pokes.
poke.failed: Could not poke. Check your connection.

map.cluster: {{count}} people together: {{names}}. Tap to zoom in.

meetUp.title: Set up a meeting with {{name}}?
meetUp.body: A meeting you run is set up and an invitation goes out. Choose the time and place right away. It ends on its own in 3 hours, and everything is deleted then.
meetUp.name: Meeting with {{name}}
meetUp.started: Meeting with {{name}} set up; choose the time and place

places.title: Places
places.empty: Home, school, work… Add a place and hear when someone arrives or leaves.
places.name: Name of the place
places.sizeHint: Drag the handle on the circle: 100, 250 or 500 m
places.moveHint: Move the map to put the place in the middle of the circle
places.deleteConfirm: Delete this place from the circle? It goes from everyone’s map.
places.conflict: Someone just changed this place. Look at it again and retry.
places.full: A circle can have at most 30 places.
places.failed: Could not save. Check your connection.
places.exactOnly: Your arrivals and departures are shared while you share your exact location with this circle.
places.encrypted: The name and location of the place are encrypted; the server cannot see them.

status.title: Your status
status.helper: Your circles see it, encrypted; it disappears when its time is up.

photo.title: Profile photo
photo.hint: Show a photo instead of your emoji if you like. It is encrypted on your phone; only your circles can open it, not even our server.
photo.saved: Your photo was sent to your circles, encrypted
photo.failed: Could not add the photo. Try again.

plan.title: Meeting
plan.noPlaces: This event has no places yet. Add one first; everyone hears when someone arrives.
plan.conflict: Someone just changed it. Look at the latest and try again.
plan.failed: Could not save. Check your connection.
plan.full: No more polls can be started in this event.
plan.forbidden: Only whoever started the poll or an admin can do this.
plan.pollHint: Tap the ones that work for you; pick as many as you like.
plan.pollCloseBody: The option with the most votes becomes the meeting’s.
plan.boardHint: Each phone estimates its own arrival and sends it, encrypted, to this event only. People not sharing their exact location do not show.
plan.remindHint: A notification 15 min before you need to set off. Estimated on your phone; no traffic data is used.
plan.leaveIn: Leave within {{minutes}} min to make the meeting

history.title: History
history.emptyMine: Turn location history on in a circle and your trail is kept while you share your exact location.
history.emptyTheirs: Kept when they turned history on for this circle and share their exact location. Nothing from before you joined shows.
history.privacy: History is encrypted on phones; the server cannot read it and deletes it after 14 days.
history.viewersEmptyBody: Turn on "Location history" on a circle's screen and its members can see your last 14 days.
history.viewersHint: Each circle only sees the history you turned on for it; people cannot see what came before they joined.
history.newViewer: {{name}} can now see your location history in {{circle}}

security.title: Security
security.eventsEmpty: No security events in the last 90 days.
security.eventsFailed: Could not load the security events. Check your connection.
security.event_login_otp: Signed in with an email code
security.event_device_replaced: Signed in on a new phone; the previous one was removed
security.event_refresh_reuse: Your session was used suspiciously and ended

lock.hint: When on, Bargu asks for Face ID, a fingerprint or your phone’s passcode when it starts and after more than a minute in the background. It only covers the screen; your location sharing carries on behind it.
lock.promptOn: Confirm to turn the app lock on
lock.promptOff: Confirm to turn the app lock off
lock.unavailable: This phone has no screen lock. Set one up in the phone’s settings first.
lock.title: Bargu is locked
lock.body: Use Face ID, a fingerprint or your phone’s passcode to carry on.

seers.title: Who sees you
seers.summary: {{count}} people in {{circles}} circles see your location right now.
seers.nobody: Nobody sees your location right now
seers.nobodyBody: Once you share with a circle, who sees you is listed here.
seers.stopAllHint: Your location leaves everyone’s map at once, nothing is sent and no history is written. Carry on with one tap whenever you like.
seers.stopped: Sharing stopped; you are off everyone’s map
seers.history: {{count}} people in {{circles}} circles can see your location history
seers.deleteHistoryBody: Location history turns off in every circle and the copy on the server is deleted. This cannot be undone.
